tracks.name: 1st Division
tracks.label: 1 Div
par: Brig. Gen. H. J. S. Landon (acting)

k.act: Marching up
k.place: Elverdinghe to Poperinghe
k.say: "the 1st Division marched from Hazebrouck through Poperinghe towards Elverdinghe" (S40 p.146)

k.act: Attack halted; holding the north face
k.place: As drawn on Sketch 4: from 1.8 km west of Bixschoote to 1.6 km north of Langemarck
k.say: "turned westwards to the canal at Steenstraat" (S40 p.163); the Guards Brigade held "a very extended line, three miles long" from Koekuit to Bixschoote Sketch 4 (S40) draws the 1st Division here for 21 October.
k.notes: Kortekeer Cabaret, behind this line, was lost on the 22nd and retaken on the 23rd. French cavalry and Territorials held the canal end. Place in the text sources, as used before v7: East of Langemarck, Koekuit, Bixschoote, the canal at Steenstraat.
k.basis: A line of 4 points read from Sketch 4 of the British official history, drawn for 21 October. Good to about 250 m.

k.act: Attack halted; holding the north face
k.place: As drawn on Sketch 7: from 1.7 km west of Bixschoote to 0.9 km north-east of Langemarck, by 1.7 km south-east of Bixschoote
k.say: "turned westwards to the canal at Steenstraat" (S40 p.163); the Guards Brigade held "a very extended line, three miles long" from Koekuit to Bixschoote Sketch 7 (S40) draws the 1st Division here for 23 October.
k.notes: Kortekeer Cabaret, behind this line, was lost on the 22nd and retaken on the 23rd. French cavalry and Territorials held the canal end. Place in the text sources, as used before v7: East of Langemarck, Koekuit, Bixschoote, the canal at Steenstraat.
k.basis: A line of 5 points read from Sketch 7 of the British official history, drawn for 23 October. Good to about 250 m.

k.act: Relieved by French Territorials; in reserve
k.place: As drawn on Sketch 8: 1.6 km north-west of Zillebeke
k.say: "The 1st Division went into reserve at Ypres" (S42) Sketch 8 (S40) draws the 1st Division as an oval behind the front, in reserve, here for 25 October.
k.notes: Sketch 8 still has the division in reserve on 25 October; S42 has it in line that day. See YC11. Place in the text sources, as used before v7: Ypres.
k.basis: A point read from Sketch 8 of the British official history, drawn for 25 October. Good to about 250 m.

k.act: In line between the 2nd and 7th Divisions
k.place: West of Reutel, Poezelhoek, Menin road at the cross-roads
k.say: "came up on the right of the 2nd Division" (S42)
k.notes: S42: from west of Reutel to the Menin road. S41 says the Germans took Reutel in these days. v7: the start is now a range, 25 to 27 October, because Sketch 8 still shows the division in reserve on the 25th (YC11). The line itself is still from the text.
pl: Gheluvelt cross-roads (Menin road and the Kruiseik-Becelaere road)

k.act: Cross-roads lost; line across the Menin road east of Gheluvelt
k.place: As drawn on Sketch 9: from 0.4 km north-west of Poezelhoek to 1.0 km south-east of Gheluvelt, by 0.4 km south of Poezelhoek
k.say: "The line of the 3rd Brigade had been drawn up across the Menin road" (S43, about 400 yards east of Gheluvelt) Sketch 9 (S40) draws the 1st Division here for 29 October.
k.notes: The north end is put at a break in the drawn line; the sketch does not mark the boundary with the 2nd Division. Place in the text sources, as used before v7: West of Reutel, Polderhoek, Menin road east of Gheluvelt.
k.basis: A line of 5 points read from Sketch 9 of the British official history, drawn for 29 October. Good to about 250 m.

k.act: New line in front of Veldhoek after Gheluvelt fell
k.place: As drawn on Sketch 10: from 0.7 km north-east of Veldhoek to 0.7 km south of Veldhoek
k.say: "about four hundred yards in advance of Veldhoek" (S43) Sketch 10 (S40) draws the 1st Division here for 31 October.
k.notes: Gheluvelt was retaken by the 2nd Worcestershire in the afternoon of the 31st, then given up when the line was straightened. Polderhoek Chateau was lost on 1 November (S41). Place in the text sources, as used before v7: South-west corner of Polygon Wood to the Menin road east of Veldhoek.
k.basis: A line of 3 points read from Sketch 10 of the British official history, drawn for 31 October. Good to about 250 m.

k.act: New line in front of Veldhoek after Gheluvelt fell
k.place: As drawn on Sketch 12: from 0.7 km north-east of Veldhoek to 0.8 km south of Veldhoek
k.say: "about four hundred yards in advance of Veldhoek" (S43) Sketch 12 (S40) draws the 1st Division here for 4 November.
k.notes: Gheluvelt was retaken by the 2nd Worcestershire in the afternoon of the 31st, then given up when the line was straightened. Polderhoek Chateau was lost on 1 November (S41). Place in the text sources, as used before v7: South-west corner of Polygon Wood to the Menin road east of Veldhoek.
k.basis: A line of 3 points read from Sketch 12 of the British official history, drawn for 4 November. Good to about 250 m.

k.act: New line in front of Veldhoek after Gheluvelt fell
k.place: As drawn on Sketch 13: from 0.9 km north of Veldhoek to 0.9 km south of Veldhoek
k.say: "about four hundred yards in advance of Veldhoek" (S43) Sketch 13 (S40) draws the 1st Division here for 9 November.
k.notes: Gheluvelt was retaken by the 2nd Worcestershire in the afternoon of the 31st, then given up when the line was straightened. Polderhoek Chateau was lost on 1 November (S41). Place in the text sources, as used before v7: South-west corner of Polygon Wood to the Menin road east of Veldhoek.
k.basis: A line of 4 points read from Sketch 13 of the British official history, drawn for 9 November. Good to about 250 m.

k.act: Line broken by the Guard and restored a little further back
k.place: As drawn on Sketch 14: from 1.2 km north of Veldhoek to Veldhoek
k.say: "capturing all the front line trenches of the 1st Brigade" (S42) Sketch 14 (S40) draws the 1st Division here for the afternoon of 11 November.
k.notes: How far back the new line lay is not in the sources read; drawn about 300 m behind the old one. Place in the text sources, as used before v7: South-west corner of Polygon Wood, east of Nonne Bosschen, Menin road west of Veldhoek.
k.basis: A line of 4 points read from Sketch 14 of the British official history, drawn for the afternoon of 11 November. Good to about 250 m.

k.act: Relieved by the French
k.place: Not given in the sources read
k.say: "I Corps was relieved by the French IX Corps and XVI Corps" (S44, for 15 to 22 November)
k.notes: No position: the day of relief and the rest area are not in the sources read.

k.act: Outposts north-east of Ypres
k.place: Wieltje, Pilckem, Steenstraat
k.say: "on the line Wieltje—Pilckem—Steenstraat" (S40 p.146)

k.act: Advance halted; entrenched
k.place: As drawn on Sketch 4: from 1.6 km north of Langemarck to 0.4 km north-west of Zonnebeke, by 1.5 km north-east of St. Julien
k.say: "from Zonnebeke Station N.N.W." to a point 1,700 yards east of Langemarck (S40 p.163) Sketch 4 (S40) draws the 2nd Division here for 21 October.
k.notes: Place in the text sources, as used before v7: Zonnebeke station, north-north-west to a point east of Langemarck.
k.basis: A line of 5 points read from Sketch 4 of the British official history, drawn for 21 October. Good to about 250 m.

k.act: Advance halted; entrenched
k.place: As drawn on Sketch 7: from 0.9 km north-east of Langemarck to 0.9 km west of Zonnebeke, by 1.3 km north of St. Julien
k.say: "from Zonnebeke Station N.N.W." to a point 1,700 yards east of Langemarck (S40 p.163) Sketch 7 (S40) draws the 2nd Division here for 23 October.
k.notes: Place in the text sources, as used before v7: Zonnebeke station, north-north-west to a point east of Langemarck.
k.basis: A line of 5 points read from Sketch 7 of the British official history, drawn for 23 October. Good to about 250 m.

k.act: Holding Polygon Wood and the Zonnebeke road
k.place: Zonnebeke road east of the village, east and south edges of Polygon Wood
k.say: "For twenty-two consecutive days from the date of the advance they occupied the Polygon wood trenches" (S42)
k.notes: The 6th Brigade pushed forward to the Passchendaele-Becelaere road on 24 and 27 October (S42). On 11 November the 1st King's held the south edge of the wood (S42; S43). Relief date: see YC02. v7: this row now covers only the days before the next dated sketch; its line is still from the text.
pl: Zonnebeke road east of the village (towards Molenaarelst)

k.act: Holding Polygon Wood and the Zonnebeke road
k.place: As drawn on Sketch 8: from Cross-roads east of Zonnebeke to Reutel
k.say: "For twenty-two consecutive days from the date of the advance they occupied the Polygon wood trenches" (S42) Sketch 8 (S40) draws the 2nd Division here for 25 October.
k.notes: The south end is put at Reutel; the sketch does not mark the boundary with the 7th Division. The 6th Brigade pushed forward to the Passchendaele-Becelaere road on 24 and 27 October (S42). On 11 November the 1st King's held the south edge of the wood (S42; S43). Relief date: see YC02. Place in the text sources, as used before v7: Zonnebeke road east of the village, east and south edges of Polygon Wood.
k.basis: A line of 4 points read from Sketch 8 of the British official history, drawn for 25 October. Good to about 250 m.

k.act: Holding Polygon Wood and the Zonnebeke road
k.place: As drawn on Sketch 9: from 1.3 km west of Keiberg to 0.5 km north-west of Poezelhoek, by 0.8 km north of Reutel
k.say: "For twenty-two consecutive days from the date of the advance they occupied the Polygon wood trenches" (S42) Sketch 9 (S40) draws the 2nd Division here for 29 October.
k.notes: The 6th Brigade pushed forward to the Passchendaele-Becelaere road on 24 and 27 October (S42). On 11 November the 1st King's held the south edge of the wood (S42; S43). Relief date: see YC02. Place in the text sources, as used before v7: Zonnebeke road east of the village, east and south edges of Polygon Wood.
k.basis: A line of 9 points read from Sketch 9 of the British official history, drawn for 29 October. Good to about 250 m.

k.act: Holding Polygon Wood and the Zonnebeke road
k.place: As drawn on Sketch 10: from 1.3 km east of Cross-roads east of Zonnebeke to 0.8 km north-east of Veldhoek, by 0.7 km north-east of Reutel
k.say: "For twenty-two consecutive days from the date of the advance they occupied the Polygon wood trenches" (S42) Sketch 10 (S40) draws the 2nd Division here for 31 October.
k.notes: The 6th Brigade pushed forward to the Passchendaele-Becelaere road on 24 and 27 October (S42). On 11 November the 1st King's held the south edge of the wood (S42; S43). Relief date: see YC02. Place in the text sources, as used before v7: Zonnebeke road east of the village, east and south edges of Polygon Wood.
k.basis: A line of 7 points read from Sketch 10 of the British official history, drawn for 31 October. Good to about 250 m.

k.act: Holding Polygon Wood and the Zonnebeke road
k.place: As drawn on Sketch 12: from 1.2 km east of Cross-roads east of Zonnebeke to 0.9 km north-east of Veldhoek, by Reutel
k.say: "For twenty-two consecutive days from the date of the advance they occupied the Polygon wood trenches" (S42) Sketch 12 (S40) draws the 2nd Division here for 4 November.
k.notes: The 6th Brigade pushed forward to the Passchendaele-Becelaere road on 24 and 27 October (S42). On 11 November the 1st King's held the south edge of the wood (S42; S43). Relief date: see YC02. Place in the text sources, as used before v7: Zonnebeke road east of the village, east and south edges of Polygon Wood.
k.basis: A line of 6 points read from Sketch 12 of the British official history, drawn for 4 November. Good to about 250 m.

k.act: Holding Polygon Wood and the Zonnebeke road
k.place: As drawn on Sketch 13: from 1.2 km east of Cross-roads east of Zonnebeke to 1.1 km north-east of Veldhoek, by 0.6 km north-east of Reutel
k.say: "For twenty-two consecutive days from the date of the advance they occupied the Polygon wood trenches" (S42) Sketch 13 (S40) draws the 2nd Division here for 9 November.
k.notes: The 6th Brigade pushed forward to the Passchendaele-Becelaere road on 24 and 27 October (S42). On 11 November the 1st King's held the south edge of the wood (S42; S43). Relief date: see YC02. Place in the text sources, as used before v7: Zonnebeke road east of the village, east and south edges of Polygon Wood.
k.basis: A line of 6 points read from Sketch 13 of the British official history, drawn for 9 November. Good to about 250 m.

k.act: Holding Polygon Wood and the Zonnebeke road
k.place: As drawn on Sketch 14: from 1.3 km north-west of Keiberg to 1.1 km north-west of Polderhoek, by 1.0 km north-east of Reutel
k.say: "For twenty-two consecutive days from the date of the advance they occupied the Polygon wood trenches" (S42) Sketch 14 (S40) draws the 2nd Division here for the afternoon of 11 November.
k.notes: The 6th Brigade pushed forward to the Passchendaele-Becelaere road on 24 and 27 October (S42). On 11 November the 1st King's held the south edge of the wood (S42; S43). Relief date: see YC02. Place in the text sources, as used before v7: Zonnebeke road east of the village, east and south edges of Polygon Wood.
k.basis: A line of 6 points read from Sketch 14 of the British official history, drawn for the afternoon of 11 November. Good to about 250 m.

k.act: Relieved by the French
k.place: Not given in the sources read
k.say: "I Corps was relieved by the French IX Corps and XVI Corps" (S44, for 15 to 22 November)
k.notes: No position.

k.act: Covering position, entrenching
k.place: Zandvoorde, Gheluvelt, Zonnebeke
k.say: "on the line Zandvoorde—Gheluvelt—Zonnebeke" (S40 p.107)
k.notes: Before the battle.

k.act: Wheeled forward towards Menin
k.place: Zandvoorde, Kruiseik, Terhand, Waterdamhoek
k.say: "a wheel forward pivoting on its right" (S40 p.115); night position Zandvoorde—Terhand—Waterdamhoek (p.120)

k.act: Attack on Menin abandoned; fell back and dug in
k.place: Zandvoorde, Kruiseik, behind Becelaere, Zonnebeke
k.say: "passed behind Becelaere to Zonnebeke" (S40 p.134); night 20/21: "Zandvoorde—Kruiseecke—Zonnebeke" (p.148)
k.notes: The order to abandon the attack came at 1 p.m. on the 19th.

k.act: Holding; left drawn back from Zonnebeke
k.place: As drawn on Sketch 4: from 0.4 km south-east of Zonnebeke to 0.4 km south-east of Zandvoorde, by Poezelhoek
k.say: "Thence the brigade front ran south-eastwards past the front of Polygon Wood" (S40 p.156) Sketch 4 (S40) draws the 7th Division here for 21 October.
k.notes: S44: the division lost Polygon Wood for a time on the 24th. Place in the text sources, as used before v7: Kruiseik, Poezelhoek, Reutel, front of Polygon Wood, Zonnebeke station.
k.basis: A line of 7 points read from Sketch 4 of the British official history, drawn for 21 October. Good to about 250 m.

k.act: Holding; left drawn back from Zonnebeke
k.place: As drawn on Sketch 7: from 0.8 km south-west of Zonnebeke to 1.1 km east of Zandvoorde, by Poezelhoek
k.say: "Thence the brigade front ran south-eastwards past the front of Polygon Wood" (S40 p.156) Sketch 7 (S40) draws the 7th Division here for 23 October.
k.notes: S44: the division lost Polygon Wood for a time on the 24th. Place in the text sources, as used before v7: Kruiseik, Poezelhoek, Reutel, front of Polygon Wood, Zonnebeke station.
k.basis: A line of 8 points read from Sketch 7 of the British official history, drawn for 23 October. Good to about 250 m.

k.act: Holding the Kruiseik salient
k.place: As drawn on Sketch 8: from Reutel to 1.2 km east of Zandvoorde, by 1.0 km north of Kruiseik
k.say: "posted in some advance trenches east of the village" (S42, 25 October) Sketch 8 (S40) draws the 7th Division here for 25 October.
k.notes: The north end is put at Reutel, where the label of the 2nd Division ends; the sketch does not mark the boundary. The line is inferred from the brigades named. S44: German attacks of 25-26 October fell on the 7th Division here. Place in the text sources, as used before v7: Menin road at the cross-roads, Kruiseik, towards Zandvoorde.
k.basis: A line of 6 points read from Sketch 8 of the British official history, drawn for 25 October. Good to about 250 m.

k.act: Kruiseik lost; line west of it
k.place: Menin road at the cross-roads, west of Kruiseik, north of Zandvoorde
k.say: "driven back from east of Kruiseik to a position west of Kruiseik" (S42)
k.notes: S41 dates the fall of Kruiseik to the 26th.
pl: Gheluvelt cross-roads (Menin road and the Kruiseik-Becelaere road)

k.act: Driven back on Gheluvelt
k.place: As drawn on Sketch 9: from 1.0 km south-east of Gheluvelt to 0.6 km east of Zandvoorde, by 1.0 km west of Kruiseik
k.say: "on the 29th we lost Kruiseik and were driven back to Gheluvelt" (S42) Sketch 9 (S40) draws the 7th Division here for 29 October.
k.notes: Place in the text sources, as used before v7: South of the Menin road at Gheluvelt, to north of Zandvoorde.
k.basis: A line of 8 points read from Sketch 9 of the British official history, drawn for 29 October. Good to about 250 m.

k.act: Right turned back after Zandvoorde fell
k.place: South of Gheluvelt to the woods north-west of Zandvoorde
k.say: "was to be held at all costs" (S42: Haig's order for the line Gheluvelt to the canal north of Hollebeke)
k.notes: S42 names the 21st and 22nd Brigades between Gheluvelt and Bulfin's Force; the line itself is inferred.

k.act: Holding south of the Menin road
k.place: As drawn on Sketch 10: from 0.7 km south of Veldhoek to 1.4 km north-west of Zandvoorde
k.say: "the Northamptons on the left, in touch with the R. Welsh Fusiliers in the 7th Division" (S42, night of 2 November) Sketch 10 (S40) draws the 7th Division here for 31 October.
k.notes: Three shattered brigades; S42 puts the 20th Brigade in reserve at Hooge Chateau on 2 November. Place in the text sources, as used before v7: Menin road at Veldhoek, Herenthage wood, woods to the south.
k.basis: A line of 3 points read from Sketch 10 of the British official history, drawn for 31 October. Good to about 250 m.

k.act: Holding south of the Menin road
k.place: As drawn on Sketch 12: from 1.0 km south of Veldhoek to 1.3 km north-west of Zandvoorde
k.say: "the Northamptons on the left, in touch with the R. Welsh Fusiliers in the 7th Division" (S42, night of 2 November) Sketch 12 (S40) draws the 7th Division here for 4 November.
k.notes: Three shattered brigades; S42 puts the 20th Brigade in reserve at Hooge Chateau on 2 November. Place in the text sources, as used before v7: Menin road at Veldhoek, Herenthage wood, woods to the south.
k.basis: A line of 2 points read from Sketch 12 of the British official history, drawn for 4 November. Good to about 250 m.

k.te: 6 November or later; not followed after this
k.act: Relieved; resting
k.place: Locre and Bailleul
k.say: "The 20th Brigade went back to Locre, and the 22nd to Bailleul" (S42)
k.notes: The 22nd Brigade was brought back by bus on 6 November for the fight at Zwarteleen (S42). Where the division went next is not in the sources read.

k.act: Screening the left of the 7th Division
k.place: Passchendaele and Poelcappelle
k.say: "near Poelcappelle" (S40 p.105, 16 October); "near Passchendaele" (p.107, 17 October)

k.act: Took Ledeghem, then fell back
k.place: Passchendaele and Poelcappelle
k.say: "withdraw the 6th Cavalry Brigade from Moorslede to Passchendaele" (S40 p.134)
k.notes: The 6th Cavalry Brigade took Ledeghem about 10.30 a.m.

k.act: Holding until I Corps came up
k.place: Zonnebeke, St. Julien, Langemarck
k.say: Night 20/21: "Zonnebeke—St. Julien—Langemarck" (S40 p.148)

k.act: In the Zandvoorde trenches
k.place: As drawn on Sketch 4: from 1.0 km south-west of Zandvoorde to 0.6 km east of Hollebeke
k.say: "the 3rd Cavalry Division took over the right of the 7th Division line near Zandvoorde" (S40 p.157) Sketch 4 (S40) draws the 3rd Cavalry Division here for 21 October.
k.notes: The 6th Cavalry Brigade held the two canal crossings north of Hollebeke (S42). Place in the text sources, as used before v7: Zandvoorde to the canal north of Hollebeke.
k.basis: A line of 2 points read from Sketch 4 of the British official history, drawn for 21 October. Good to about 250 m.

k.act: In the Zandvoorde trenches
k.place: As drawn on Sketch 8: from 0.7 km south-east of Zandvoorde to 1.0 km east of Hollebeke
k.say: "the 3rd Cavalry Division took over the right of the 7th Division line near Zandvoorde" (S40 p.157) Sketch 8 (S40) draws the 3rd Cavalry Division here for 25 October.
k.notes: The line is the same, within reading error, on Sketches 7, 8 and 9 (23, 25 and 29 October); one row covers them. The 6th Cavalry Brigade held the two canal crossings north of Hollebeke (S42). Place in the text sources, as used before v7: Zandvoorde to the canal north of Hollebeke.
k.basis: A line of 2 points read from Sketch 8 of the British official history, drawn for 25 October. Good to about 250 m.

k.act: Driven off the Zandvoorde ridge
k.place: Klein Zillebeke
k.say: "reformed at Klein Zillebeke in the rear" (S43)
k.notes: The trenches were lost soon after nine in the morning (S42).

k.act: Corps reserve, sent wherever the line gave
k.place: Verbranden Molen
k.say: "kept at Verbranden Molen ready for emergencies" (S42, 31 October)
k.notes: One brigade or another was in the line most days. S41 puts the division in Herenthage wood on 1 November.

k.act: Counter-attack at Zwarteleen; then holding the ridge
k.place: Zwarteleen
k.say: "regained, at the point of the bayonet, the whole of the position lost" (S42, 6 November)
k.notes: Shares this ground with Cavan's Force; the sources do not separate them. S43: the division repelled the attack of 17 November. v7: drawn as a point at Zwarteleen. Sketches 13 and 14 write the division's name behind Cavan's line, not on it. Zwarteleen as read from Sketch A lies about 250 m outside Cavan's line as read from those sketches: the two readings differ by about their own error.

tracks.name: 1st Cavalry Division
tracks.label: 1 Cav Div
par: Maj. Gen. H. de B. de Lisle

k.act: Probing the Lys crossings
k.place: West of Pont Rouge and Warneton
k.say: "to within three hundred yards of Pont Rouge" (S40 p.115, 2nd Cavalry Brigade)
k.notes: The split between the two cavalry divisions on these days is inferred.

k.act: Holding the line facing Warneton
k.place: St. Yves to Messines
k.say: "on the general line St. Yves—Messines" (S40 p.144, 6 p.m.)

k.act: Holding Messines
k.place: As drawn on Sketch 8: from 0.4 km north-east of Messines to 1.2 km south of Messines
k.say: "part of its front up to the Douve" was taken over by the 4th Division (S40 p.153) Sketch 8 (S40) draws the 1st Cavalry Division here for 25 October.
k.notes: The line is the same, within reading error, on Sketches 4, 7, 8 and 9 (21 to 29 October); one row covers them. Place in the text sources, as used before v7: The Douve to Messines.
k.basis: A line of 2 points read from Sketch 8 of the British official history, drawn for 25 October. Good to about 250 m.

k.act: Fighting in Messines
k.place: As drawn on Sketch 10: from 0.8 km north of Messines to 1.3 km south of Messines, by Messines
k.say: "by 2 p.m. they were all in the town" (S42) Sketch 10 (S40) draws the 1st Cavalry Division here for 31 October.
k.notes: Place in the text sources, as used before v7: Messines.
k.basis: A line of 5 points read from Sketch 10 of the British official history, drawn for 31 October. Good to about 250 m.

k.te: 2 November or later; not followed after this
k.act: Messines lost; withdrawn behind the French
k.place: Wulverghem
k.say: "withdrawn to Wulverghem" (S42)
k.notes: S42 does not date the withdrawal; "early November". Not followed after this.

k.act: In support behind the French line
k.place: As drawn on Sketch 13: from 1.9 km north of Wulverghem to 1.2 km east of Wulverghem, by 0.9 km north-east of Wulverghem
k.say: Sketch 13 (S40) draws the 1st Cavalry Division here for 9 November.
k.notes: The line is behind the French front, not on it. On Sketch 14 (11 November) the 2nd Cavalry Division is here instead.
k.basis: A line of 6 points read from Sketch 13 of the British official history, drawn for 9 November. Good to about 250 m.

k.act: Attack across the Lys made no progress
k.place: North-west of Warneton, Houthem, west of Tenbrielen
k.say: "attacked from Deûlémont to Tenbrielen but made no progress" (S45, citing Edmonds)
k.notes: The split between the two cavalry divisions on these days is inferred.

k.act: Holding from Garde Dieu to Kortewilde
k.place: Garde Dieu, the Wambeke, Houthem, Kortewilde
k.say: "through Garde Dieu along the Wambeke stream to Houthem and Kortewilde" (S40 p.144)

k.act: Kortewilde lost; holding from Messines to the canal
k.place: As drawn on Sketch 4: from Hollebeke to 0.4 km north-east of Messines, by 2.0 km north-west of Garde Dieu
k.say: "Kortewilde was occupied by the enemy" (S40 p.153) Sketch 4 (S40) draws the 2nd Cavalry Division here for 21 October.
k.notes: S42 gives the cavalry line on 30 October as from the canal at Hollebeke to the Douve south of Messines. Place in the text sources, as used before v7: North-east of Messines, east of Oosttaverne, Hollebeke.

events.name: Encounter
events.text: Four new German reserve corps strike the Allied cavalry screen. Roulers falls and the British 7th Division gives up its advance on Menin.

events.name: Ridge lost
events.text: The Germans take Passchendaele and Becelaere. The British I Corps arrives behind Ypres.

events.name: I Corps halted
events.text: Haig's attack towards Poelcappelle and Langemarck is stopped in the afternoon; the French cavalry withdraws behind the canal.

events.name: Langemarck
events.text: The Germans break in at Kortekeer Cabaret on the 22nd; the British retake it on the 23rd. Mass attacks on Langemarck fail.

events.name: French take over
events.text: The French IX Corps and Territorials relieve the British 2nd and 1st Divisions in the north. The Germans cross the Yser at Tervaete.

events.name: Kruiseik lost
events.text: German cavalry and the XXVII Reserve Corps take Kruiseik from the 7th Division.

events.name: Cross-roads lost
events.text: A dawn attack in fog takes the cross-roads south-east of Gheluvelt. Army Group Fabeck assembles behind the cavalry.

events.name: Fabeck attacks
events.text: Zandvoorde and Hollebeke fall to the new army group. The Belgians flood the Yser plain and the Germans there withdraw that night.

events.name: Gheluvelt
events.text: Gheluvelt falls about 1.30 p.m.; the 2nd Worcestershire retake it and the line is re-formed in front of Veldhoek. Messines is stormed.

events.name: Messines ridge lost
events.text: Messines and Wytschaete pass to the Germans. The French XVI Corps takes over west of the ridge.

events.name: 7th Division relieved
events.text: Brigades of II Corps take over south of the Menin road. On the 6th the Germans take Klein Zillebeke and are checked at Zwarteleen.

events.name: Dixmude and St. Eloi
events.text: Dixmude falls, the Germans reach the canal north of Ypres, and the Bavarians take St. Eloi.

events.name: Nonne Bosschen
events.text: The Prussian Guard breaks through north of the Menin road, reaches Nonne Bosschen and is driven out.

events.name: Offensive called off
events.text: A last attack south of the Menin road fails and the Fourth Army gives up the offensive.

events.name: End (British date)
events.text: The French have taken over the salient from the British I Corps. The British official history ends the battle here.
